title: isodon calycinus
intro: Isodon calycinus, commonly known as Chinese lavender or mountain mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Isodon calycinus include its sedative, antiseptic, and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Isodon calycinus include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
